original_test_intent: Perform an explicitly approved in-band firmware upgrade or downgrade on each intended GPU and NVSwitch, then prove requested target versions and complete fabric/driver recovery.
original_method: Inventory UUID/BDF/board/topology and current versions; map each device/component to a signed image, direction and target; validate nvflash build/options, compatibility, ordering and downgrade authorization; drain jobs and preserve evidence; flash one approved target at a time with full logs; activate/reboot only as specified; verify all targeted and untargeted device, NVLink/PCIe/driver and management health; retain rollback.
manual_activity: Firmware owner defines each target/image/direction and recovery; operator drains jobs and authorizes every flash/activation; agent may execute only approved target-specific commands.
required_inputs: Signed per-target image hashes with current/target versions and upgrade/downgrade direction
Approved nvflash build and exact target/write options
Compatibility, ordering, activation/reboot and downgrade policy
Known-good rollback/vendor recovery, console/OOB and maintenance approval
safety_requirements: Never expand all or a VBIOS placeholder into targets
Verify each image belongs to the exact component before one write
Stop on unsupported downgrade, mapping/version mismatch or warning
Do not proceed to another target after any anomaly; preserve logs
No automatic retry, forced flag or rollback without fresh engineer control
agent_execution_scope: Validate per-target manifest and immutable artifacts
Capture baseline and execute one approved target at a time
Collect flash/activation/readback and complete fabric health evidence
engineer_actions: Resolve component/image mapping and approve downgrade/order/activation
Authorize each write and own recovery/rollback

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only `nvflash --version` neither performs the source upgrade/downgrade nor proves firmware; generic `./nvflash <$VBIOS>.rom` is unsafe for mixed GPU/NVSwitch targets.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Invoke the vendor-documented target-specific NVFlash write only for one approved device/component and matched signed image, retain full log, then activate and verify before any next target.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: In-band, both upgrade/downgrade directions and all intended GPU/NVSwitch coverage are preserved; targets and images are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed transaction manifest with one row per physical device/component, planned before/after version, exact argv and recovery artifact; gate each next write on prior target health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes blanket flashing and makes mixed GPU/NVSwitch component ownership explicit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A utility-version query is not a firmware update, while one GPU VBIOS file cannot be assumed valid for NVSwitch firmware.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: One bad write can disrupt NVLink fabric or make the device unreachable; recovery capability must be proven before the first write.

project_override_considerations: Firmware owner defines whether GPU VBIOS and NVSwitch firmware are separate sub-operations, their order, and device-specific downgrade support.
expected_evidence: Per-device/component identity/topology and signed image manifest
Pre/target/post versions, direction and exact approved argv
NVFlash binary hash, full logs, exit and activation/reboot record
All targeted and untargeted GPU/NVSwitch enumeration plus NVLink/PCIe/driver health
SEL/dmesg/BMC/console deltas and active jobs/services recovery

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure applies one `$VBIOS` placeholder to all GPUs and NVSwitches even though component images/targets may differ and no mapping or direction is defined.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution remains gated by project-supplied firmware artifacts, mapping and approvals.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row268 Wistron-NV GPU-00261-V002: define separate GPU VBIOS and NVSwitch component scopes rather than one blanket `$VBIOS` file, with per-device images/current-target versions, upgrade or downgrade direction, nvflash target/options/order, activation/reboot, rollback and OOB recovery.

review_improvement: Transforms an unsafe blanket placeholder into a sequenced per-target firmware transaction with evidence and recovery boundaries.
independent_technical_reasoning: GPU VBIOS and NVSwitch firmware serve different devices and may require different payload formats and selection semantics. A command without an explicit target can affect more devices than intended, and downgrades may cross anti-rollback or dependency boundaries. Sequential gating limits blast radius and lets link/fabric health reveal incompatibility before another component is modified.
